summary: Exact17-file integrated catalog matches W4 manifest; six tests, validator, Node synthetic exact-source helpers and Python edge AST probe pass. R101 hidden-rail/width-default corrections independently confirmed. Require narrow input/metadata hardening before treating catalog guards as reliable validation: positive distinct widths, substantive resolvable guard contracts, and package-contained source paths. Recipes remain declarative; no production or scientific acceptance inferred.
integration: Integrated experiments/capability-discovery/catalog present and all17 manifest hashes match independently reviewed scratch source; integration-check.json.

R101Confirmed.note: Tracker consumption of combined/interior-only evidence confirmed; no rail identity inferred.

requiredAmendments.finding: widthEvidence supports synthetic widthPx=-40 and duplicate width40 conflicting rows as EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED. Neither is a valid separated positive-width hypothesis.
requiredAmendments.requirement: Require positive finite widths, distinct unambiguous candidate widths, finite nonnegative integer segment/candidate/visible sample counts, and counts consistent with rows. Add adversarial negative/duplicate/nonfinite/fractional cases; preserve hidden/tied/missing UNKNOWN.

requiredAmendments.finding: validateCatalog accepts candidate_pools_available contract={} and a width guard module missing.mjs#pretend. Existing check only Boolean(contract), so named guarded recipe metadata can silently lose its contract.
requiredAmendments.requirement: For each guard require declared recognized contract shape: nonempty predicate/requirements and valid local module export or known external contract when referenced. Keep recipes declarative; no arbitrary expression execution or invented candidate completeness proof.

requiredAmendments.finding: Changing source.file to an absolute same-content path outside package still validates PASS. Source bytes are hash-verified, but package-contained portability is not checked.
requiredAmendments.requirement: Require safe package-relative source file paths and real containment; reject absolute paths, traversal and escaping symlinks before reads. Preserve source exact-byte identities.

scopeFindings: Catalog callable symbols, source coordinate frames, units and input/output contracts are explicit; executed-source helpers match documented frames, routing scale2/yOffset100, source-native costs and candidate IDs.
No arbitrary new3bend weight or CV algorithm introduced; source-native defaults preserved, px-scale defaults explicitly not zoom-global.

Recipes do not execute candidate-availability or independent-review workflow. Candidate pools availability is caller contract, never endpoint completeness; independent human acceptance belongs to W3 planner/coordinator and Sam, not this catalog.
Injected operation acceptance=accepted is correctly rejected by validator. Missing external adapter source dependency is correctly rejected.
limitations: Eight toolkit snapshot origins independently matched exact git ref bytes. Dev72 ref unavailable in toolkit objects; SHA256+Git blob independently recomputed match manifest, original upstream not freshly retrieved.
Full scoring, edge profile/fit/refine and course replay not executed; source-symbol coverage is accurately distinguished.
All mutations/probes synthetic; no real image width confidence, heldout course evaluation, performance, endpoint geometry or acceptance evidence.
next: Root/W3 owner repairs these structural guards/validator without new CV; W6 reruns independently against changed exact hashes. No self acceptance.
